Later updates preserve the same immutable OPEN historical snapshot through decrease to zero and increase, reject repricing and do not authorize descriptor revival.

Assigned lineage is defensively copied, checked against the prior origin and included in exact precommit read-set validation.
Original signature, role, resource, registration, Route, exact prior, retry and source checks precede capacity; capacity receives the exact candidate or explicit null and failures propagate.
